Do not substitute 2023 or 2025–2026 material. Do not guess subjects from the user's later projects. Include mathematical reasoning in applied discussions when present, but omit nonmathematical material. Mark unavailable original prompts and missing dates clearly. I need the actual historical evidence, not a generic mathematics syllabus or a summary of the current request.
